newsitem.title: USA: Catherines Stores to take Q4 $1 mln charge.
newsitem.headline: Catherines Stores to take Q4 $1 mln charge.

text.p: Catherines Stores Corp said Thursday it would take a pre-tax write-down of assets of about $1 million in its fourth quarter, as required by Financial Accounting Standards No. 121.

The write-down mostly relates to stores opened in the past two years whose future cash flows are projected to be less than the company's investment in fixtures and leasehold improvements, Catherines Stores said.
It said the write-down would have no impact on cash flow.
The company closed three underperforming stores in January and said it plans to open six new stores in the first quarter.
